provenance.source: hand-written in this repository, each row executable so the grader runs the answer rather than reading it

cases.prompt:
Write a JavaScript ES module that exports `fizzbuzz(n)`. It returns an array of strings for the numbers 1 to n: "Fizz" for multiples of 3, "Buzz" for multiples of 5, "FizzBuzz" for multiples of both, otherwise the number as a string.

Reply with a single ```js code block containing the complete ES module and nothing else.

Write a JavaScript ES module that exports `parseDuration(text)`. It parses strings made of one or more `<integer><unit>` parts with units h, m and s, in that order and each at most once (for example "1h30m", "45s", "2h5s"), and returns the total number of seconds. Any other input, including an empty string, throws a TypeError.

Reply with a single ```js code block containing the complete ES module and nothing else.

Write a JavaScript ES module that exports `groupBy(items, key)`. It returns a plain object mapping each distinct value of `item[key]` to the array of items with that value, keeping the original item order inside each group.

Reply with a single ```js code block containing the complete ES module and nothing else.

Write a JavaScript ES module that exports a class `LruCache`. `new LruCache(capacity)` creates a cache holding at most `capacity` entries. `get(key)` returns the value or undefined and marks the key as most recently used. `set(key, value)` inserts or updates the key, marks it most recently used, and evicts the least recently used entry when the cache is over capacity.

Reply with a single ```js code block containing the complete ES module and nothing else.

Write a JavaScript ES module that exports `compareSemver(a, b)` for versions of the form MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with non-negative integer parts. It returns -1 when a is lower, 1 when a is higher and 0 when they are equal, comparing each part numerically.

Reply with a single ```js code block containing the complete ES module and nothing else.
